transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I suppose it’s that I have trouble staying seated in situations where I should. Meetings, dinner, things like that. I’ll get up to refill coffee or check something at the back of the room, even when it isn’t really necessary. It’s become noticeable.
Were you like this as a child?

Yes… I think so. My report cards used to say I was bright, but that I couldn’t stay in my seat or wait my turn. My mother used to joke I wore a path between my desk and the pencil sharpener before I was ten.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people did not?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve never had anything like that, as far as I know.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or on top of the world?
Not really… I mean, I’ve had good moods like anyone, but nothing I’d call unusually high or euphoric.
Do you often feel unable to control your worrying?
I wouldn’t say often. I worry sometimes, of course, but… I don’t think it feels out of control.
